parameters.query: SET @demo_review_locked=NULL; SELECT ticket_id INTO @demo_review_locked FROM ai_support_portfolio_demo.tickets WHERE ticket_id=SUBSTRING($1,2) FOR UPDATE; UPDATE ai_support_portfolio_demo.tickets SET processing_status=SUBSTRING($2,2),requires_review=0 WHERE ticket_id=SUBSTRING($3,2) AND processing_status='PENDING_REVIEW' AND requires_review=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_support_portfolio_demo.ticket_audit WHERE ticket_id=SUBSTRING($4,2) AND event_key='DEMO_HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1'); SET @demo_review_updated=ROW_COUNT(); INSERT INTO ai_support_portfolio_demo.ticket_audit(ticket_id,event_key,event_type,previous_status,new_status,reviewer_id,execution_id,details) SELECT ticket_id,'DEMO_HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1','HUMAN_REVIEW_DECIDED','PENDING_REVIEW',processing_status, SUBSTRING($5,2),SUBSTRING($6,2),JSON_OBJECT('decisionId',SUBSTRING($7,2),'decision',SUBSTRING($8,2),'reason',SUBSTRING($9,2),'policyVersion',policy_version,'originalEscalation',review_reason,'originalCategory',classification_category) FROM ai_support_portfolio_demo.tickets WHERE ticket_id=SUBSTRING($10,2) AND @demo_review_updated=1; SET @demo_review_audited=ROW_COUNT(); SELECT t.ticket_id,t.processing_status,a.reviewer_id,a.new_status,a.details,a.occurred_at,@demo_review_updated updated_rows,@demo_review_audited audit_rows FROM (SELECT 1 x) seed LEFT JOIN ai_support_portfolio_demo.tickets t ON t.ticket_id=SUBSTRING($11,2) LEFT JOIN ai_support_portfolio_demo.ticket_audit a ON a.ticket_id=t.ticket_id AND a.event_key='DEMO_HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1';

SELECT t.ticket_id,LEFT(t.customer_message,1500) customer_message,t.classification_category,t.classification_reason,t.requires_review,t.review_reason,t.processing_status,t.policy_version,t.created_at,t.updated_at,a.audit_id,a.event_type,a.previous_status,a.new_status,a.reviewer_id,a.execution_id,a.details,a.occurred_at
FROM ai_support_portfolio_demo.tickets t LEFT JOIN ai_support_portfolio_demo.ticket_audit a ON a.ticket_id=t.ticket_id AND SUBSTRING($1,2)='detail'
WHERE (SUBSTRING($2,2)='pending' AND t.processing_status='PENDING_REVIEW' AND t.requires_review=1)
OR (SUBSTRING($3,2)='history' AND t.processing_status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_support_portfolio_demo.ticket_audit h WHERE h.ticket_id=t.ticket_id AND h.event_key='DEMO_HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1'))
OR (SUBSTRING($4,2)='detail' AND t.ticket_id=SUBSTRING($5,2))
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC,t.ticket_id,a.audit_id LIMIT 50;
